verdict.rationale: Groq's core API is a natural-language chat/completions interface (text-chat, tool-use, Responses API) so end users of apps built on Groq interact via NL, and MCP/tool-use docs show it can act agentically on NL instructions. However there's no evidence that the Groq platform/console itself (billing, deployment, service-tier config) can be operated via natural-language commands — those are set via API parameters/dashboard, not NL. Missing for 10: evidence of NL-driven control of the Groq console/account settings, and independent confirmation of agentic NL command execution beyond docs.
